jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Business Engineering is looking for impact-focused, entrepreneurial engineers ready to bring their ideas and make a difference. We are technology experts that apply our software engineering skills to bring a unique blend of business and technology expertise to ensure our clients succeed. Business Engineers work directly with our clients — starting from their challenges and using deep platform expertise to design solutions and help clients integrate with Meta. Our team is at the intersection of business and innovation where you will execute on solving real-world business challenges through Meta's platforms and community in many of today's most exciting industries and products. These include Video, Commerce, Monetization, Metaverse, Gaming, Creators, AI, Messaging and more.

You will write scalable production-grade code across Meta's platforms in collaboration with other product engineering teams. You will get to learn and build on different tech stacks and languages. You will use your entrepreneurial passion and the freedom that the role provides to create your own opportunities and choose how you make an impact.

The work we do exceeds the boundaries of what is possible quickly, and at scale. Our work transcends technology and ensures the solutions we build translates into prosperity for all. Our code is designed to engineer and accelerate business growth. Growth is great. Rapid growth is better. Our approach aims to maximize positive impact for our clients as well as the billions of people that use their products and services.
jobs.responsibilitiesRaw: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to Meta's clients — working directly with them to understand their challenges, helping them integrate with Meta's platforms, and feeding field insights back to Product teams to shape platform capabilities From market insights, build new products and improve existing ones in collaboration with Meta product engineering teams and cross functional partners to meet business needs Understand and apply deep knowledge of products, technologies, and business to build solutions to solve for problems at scale Design and build end-to-end systems and launch-plan strategies Guide workflow changes, and gain consensus from stakeholders while driving toward solutions Respond and maintain effective communication with clients and internal stakeholders Work with clients to develop a long-term strategic plan, grounded on business objectives, and manage clients during integrations with Meta's platform products and ensure value creation Build and manage strong working relationships with technical counterparts. Mentor and share knowledge with peers, creating positive atmosphere amongst team Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback while quickly actioning feedback from code reviews conducted of your code Influence decision-making through presentation of data-centric business topics Serve as a subject matter expert within Business Engineering and provide consultation on domain-level project Participate in interviewing and onboarding of new team members Willingness to travel 25% of the time

jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Meta’s Product Risk & Compliance teams are at the forefront of embedding privacy, integrity, and regulatory compliance into the company’s most critical products and systems.

We are looking for a seasoned engineering leader to join our Risk teams, which will put you right at the heart of some of the company’s most important investments and challenges. Our teams work horizontally across the whole company, identifying emerging patterns and creating solutions for controls that allow the company to move fast, turning Meta’s compliance strategy into a competitive advantage.

Your team’s work will range from working on company-wide responses to new laws, through supporting product teams across Meta on both technical strategy, to building centralized technology systems that allow Meta products to be compliant-by-design in code.

You’ll influence technical decision making and company strategy as well as driving prioritization and execution, while managing outstanding engineers and engineering managers in a fast-paced, impact focused environment. We are looking for someone with a strong technical foundation plus a track record of structuring healthy organizations that encourage effective collaborations across multiple disciplines.
jobs.responsibilitiesRaw: Build, manage and support diverse teams of software engineers and engineering managers Drive strategy for company trajectory-altering problems, managing relationships with executive leadership and coordinating execution plans with partner orgs, ensuring we meet legal and regulatory commitments while optimizing for company efficiency. Provide both technical and organizational leadership Form cross-functional and cross-discipline partnerships to drive engineering efforts Uphold a culture of respect, integrity, inclusion, innovation Demonstrated experience recruiting, building, structuring, leading technical organizations, including performance management Embrace a constantly evolving environment where the process is fluid and creative solutions are operationalized at a very fast pace.
jobs.minimumQualificationsRaw: Significant technical industry experience Extensive management experience Graduate degree preferred

jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Core Delivery Products is the Ads pillar that builds the products that power the core capabilities of our ads system: from targeting, to bidding, optimization, and user quality. The team has a strong and long-standing track record of making critical contributions to company top line goals with most of Meta revenue flowing through these core systems, and our year on year improvements continuing to drive significant top-line impact. 

In EMEA, we have 3 complete sub-pillars operating with high autonomy: Targeting, Core Ads Quality, & Direct Response Optimization. All the sub-pillars are responsible for growing revenue, machine learning product solutions end to end, alongside the reliability and stability of these core products. All have their cross functional teams co-located with them.

jobs.aboutTheJobRaw: Meta is seeking Ads Engineers to join our engineering team. This role requires industry experience working on a range of AI and optimization problems in ads or related products. The position will involve taking these skills and applying them to some of the most exciting and massive social data and prediction problems that exist on the web.

jobs.aboutTheJobRaw: Meta is seeking talented engineers to join our teams in building cutting-edge products that connect billions of people around the world. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work on complex technical problems, build new features, and improve existing products across various platforms, including mobile devices and web applications. Our teams are constantly pushing the boundaries of user experience, and we're looking for passionate individuals who can help us advance the way people connect globally. If you're interested in joining a world-class team of engineers and researchers to work on exciting projects that have significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
